values.DataCenterNotes: Boardwalk's April 2025 release for the Borealis open season names data centers among the customers the project will serve. It lists electric utilities, power producers, gas utilities, producers, LNG exporters, industrial users and data centers. It describes data centers as driving the digital economy. No specific data center is named.

verifications.note: Boardwalk release says Borealis supplies gas for utilities, power producers, LNG exporters, industrials and data centers driving the digital economy.

records.researcher_notes: A Boardwalk Pipelines release from April 2025 names data centers among the customers and demand drivers for the Borealis Project. No named campus or shipper.

values.DataCenterNotes: Mississippi Today reported in October 2026 on the project's filing with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission. The filing forecasts Southeast demand growth from electric vehicles, heating electrification and data centers. No specific data center or shipper is named. Opponents dispute the data center forecast.

verifications.note: Article says Kinder Morgan's filing for Mississippi Crossing forecasts demand from industries including electric vehicles, heating electrification and data centers.

records.researcher_notes: A Mississippi Today article from October 2026 reports that the company's federal filing for Mississippi Crossing lists data centers among its demand drivers. Opponent reports are not used as the basis.

values.DataCenterNotes: Energy Transfer's August 2025 release names data center expansion, with population growth and high-tech industry, as a demand driver for the Desert Southwest expansion. No specific data center is named.
